meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude会帮你为项目配置“语言服务器”，让编辑器支持诊断、跳转定义、查找引用、重命名等功能。它会按文件扩展名识别语言，给出安装和配置步骤，并用脚本检测和验证服务器。
howto.when: 当你要求配置或安装语言服务器、修复相关报错，或选择服务器时触发。

say.text: 为这个Python项目配置语言服务器。
say.note: Claude会按扩展名识别项目语言，给出安装和配置指引。

say.text: 帮我修复“语言服务器未安装”的报错。
say.note: Claude会找到对应的服务器安装命令并指导执行。

say.text: 检查一下这个项目的LSP配置。
say.note: Claude会运行检测脚本，报告每个服务器的安装和配置状态。

howto.what_en: Claude configures language servers so your editor can do diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, and rename. It detects the language by file extension, gives setup steps, and verifies with scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to configure or install a language server, fix related errors, or choose between servers.

say_en.text: Set up a language server for this Python project.
say_en.note: Claude will detect the project and give setup steps.

say_en.text: Fix the 'language server not installed' error.
say_en.note: Claude will show the install command and guide you.

say_en.text: Check the LSP configuration for this project.
say_en.note: Claude will run detection and report server status.
